pkgmetadata.longdescription: Complete hand-rendered colored-pencil and pastel raster sibling of the supplied Breeze Painted family: 7,172 exact named 128-pixel RGBA PNG paths, 3,261 independently generated canonical drawings, source-bound atlas provenance and preserved LGPL notices. All twelve XDG categories are discoverable. Data-only installation preserves theme selection and depends only on hicolor at runtime.
